posts.subject: Luckiris's application for knife server
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello, this my application for being a test admin on knife server.


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame

Hello, my real name is Arnaud, I’m French. I live in the city of Dijon, Burgundy, France. My name in all my games is Luckiris.


2) How old are you?

I’m currently 19, my birthday is on April, 29th.

3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?

There is many reasons. First, I like the existing admins because they are nice and funny, they bring a good atmosphere on the servers. Second, I want to help the existing admin to enforce the rules because sometimes people are disrespecting other players. Third, I like the quality of the Dream servers.


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?

Currently, I have more than 10700 stamm points so it’s a bit more than 180h on knife server, I don’t play a lot on other servers except the bhop server.


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?

I like to do a lot of things.
I like to listen all kind of music (especially music of my favorite movies and games like Star Wars, the Lords of the ring),watching movies and series like Games of Thrones, Gotham, Star Wars.
I like to chill out with my friends of course.
I like computing science but it's more than a passion for me because I want to work in this domain in a few years. I would like to work in network security, or at least in a security job in computing.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature?

I think I’m mature because I try to stay calm every time even if I’m triggered or mad because it’s useless to bother other people and as an adult I act as an adult so I don't take decision on a player just because he killed me, I think before I act.


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?

I was admin on a few little servers on counter strike source, it was on normal servers and on a minigame servers so I learned a bit how to manage a lot of players and how to keep them calm.


[8)] When do you play? (Timetable of your average week)

I try to play every days:

  • Week days : from 19:00 to 23:00 and maybe in the afternoon if I have no class at my university.
  • Week-end : I can play all the day long if I have nothing else to do.

9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?

When I had this situation on my precedent admin jobs, I was working by following this logic.
First of all, I need to find if they are friends or if they know each others because it would means they are just trolling. In any case, I just warn them in verbal chat and I explain to them than they should stop because they are annoying people.
If they continue, I warn them in both chats (verbal and non-verbal) and I explain to them that it’s my last warning before I take an appropriate action on them. Usually, it’s my last warning but sometimes I do a third warning like the second one.


In a last resort, I take an appropriate action ( for example : slay, mute, beacon, firebomb, ...)


Patterns of my actions :

  • Pattern 1: appropriate action –|- kick –|- kick –|- ban
  • Pattern 2: appropriate action –|- appropriate action –|- kick –|- ban
  • Pattern 3: appropriate action –|- appropriate action –|- kick –|- kick –|- ban

10) Strengths

  • Serious: I’m a serious guy when I need to take important decisions.
  • Kind, nice and respectful: I’m kind and nice to everyone in any circumstances.
  • Available: You can talk to me whenever you want on teamspeak or in game.
  • I try to not bother people if there are not happy or if they are busy.
  • Atmosphere: Keep a good atmosphere on servers is important for me.
  • Connected: I’m connected as long as possible every day.

11) Weaknesses


  • My English is not perfect. (People who knows meknow that I have problems with H)
  • Excited: I can get a bit excited but not forlong.
  • I am triggered when someone talks aboutterrorist attacks in France because when someone talks about that, it’s to makejokes on this and I don’t like this because it’s like not being respectful tothe family who lost someone.
  • Not enough active on the forum. It’s my secondtimes in my life that I use a forum so i will try to be more active. For now, I try to check the forums every day.

12) Conclusion / Closing remark

In conclusion,
I think I could make a good admin because I have good relationships with people and I like this community because I met a lot of nice people on your servers and I really want to help the community to become better and better.
Thanks for taking time to read this application and thanks for all the people who are supporting me and most of all, thanks for bringing me a lot of fun every day on your servers.
